an5.27:1.1: Samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvetha appamāṇaṃ nipakā patissatā.
an5.27:1.2: Samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvayataṃ appamāṇaṃ nipakānaṃ patissatānaṃ pañca ñāṇāni paccattaṃ yeva uppajjanti.
an5.27:1.4: ‘Ayaṃ samādhi paccuppannasukho c'eva āyatiñ ca sukhavipāko' ti paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati,
an5.27:1.5: ‘ayaṃ samādhi ariyo nirāmiso 'ti paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati,
an5.27:1.6: ‘ayaṃ samādhi akāpurisasevito' ti paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati,
an5.27:1.7: ‘ayaṃ samādhi santo paṇīto paṭippassaddhiladdho ekodibhāvādhigato na ca sasaṅkhāraniggayhavāritāvaṭo' ti paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati,
an5.27:1.8: ‘so kho panāhaṃ imaṃ samādhiṃ sato 'va samāpajjāmi sato 'va vuṭṭhahāmī' ti paccattaṃ yeva ñāṇaṃ uppajjati.
an5.27:2.1: Samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvetha appamāṇaṃ nipakā patissatā.
an5.27:2.2: Samādhiṃ bhikkhave bhāvayataṃ appamāṇaṃ nipakānaṃ patissatānaṃ imāni pañca ñāṇāni paccattaṃ yeva uppajjantī
